decisions.subject: Heavyweight book
decisions.lean: Day-1 build from $1M cash. I press Flagship's best ideas that also sit in my tradable universe, but size to the regime: Goldilocks yet TRANSITIONING with a hawkish Fed and a published NEUTRAL / ROTATE_DEFENSIVE posture (offense budget 0.43) argue for a quality-defensive tilt with real cash held, not max gross. Concentrated 5-name book, ~76% invested / ~24% cash, one name per correlated cluster: healthcare barbell — CI (managed care; the board's #1 early-edge with a radar POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, research 85) and INCY (biotech, 90) — plus three distinct-driver industrials: SWK (tools, Flagship's top conviction at 95), WAB (rail, 89), and APH (electrification/AI connectors, a Flagship repeat-add). Every name is Flagship-held, research-desk 'compelling'/recommend=true, and clears its multi-sided conviction gate with no hard vetoes. I deliberately hold cash rather than force conviction into a neutral tape — confirmation over prediction — and will press winners as the transition resolves and confluence firms.
